title: Technical Stack
objectives: Support a search-engine-friendly public website and a complete AI movie-production application.
Support story, screenplay, character, location, scene, shot, take, generation, audio, editing, rendering, and export workflows.

findings.dry_run_issue: A source-build dependency encountered a network failure; this does not prove Python itself is incompatible.

ai_media_processing.recommendation: Use Termux for basic Python development and suitable lightweight tests. Verify and run the complete Python service stack in a compatible Linux environment.

database.media_policy: Store large media binaries in suitable media/object storage. Keep structured metadata, ownership, status, and storage references in PostgreSQL.

security_principles: Keep API keys and provider credentials server-side.
Never expose private credentials in frontend JavaScript.
Do not commit secrets to Git.
Use environment variables or suitable secret management.
Implement runtime input validation, authentication, and authorization.
Protect user projects and media assets from unauthorized access.
Apply quotas, rate limits, and generation cost controls.
Use encrypted connections for production services.
Never request private API keys or database passwords in chat.
